context: Run a tuned ClickHouse benchmark against a real server (see uat-clickhouse-server-* items for stack setup), then read the .applied.json companion: check receipt.entries kinds/verdicts and the executed-statement order behind applied_ledger_hash. Compare against system.tables sorting_key/partition_key directly.
description: PR #1331 (merged 2026-07-29) changed when a ClickHouse run may reach applied_verified, but every claim rests on a FAKE system.tables connection — no live ClickHouse was available. Ladder step 2 of clickhouse-tuning-ledger-soundness-1275-followups-20260724 was never run, and that item was completed without it. Four behaviours need live proof: (1) a combined PARTITION BY/ORDER BY table does NOT reach applied_verified unless the catalog partition_key corroborates; (2) a date-partitioned table (generator renders toYYYYMM(col)) DOES corroborate — the clause regex now captures the full expression, and getting this wrong silently blocks every date-partitioned run from ever verifying; (3) a partition-only tuned table is recorded and its unapplied partition blocks the run; (4) applied_ledger_hash orders CREATE TABLE before OPTIMIZE TABLE. Note (2) is the regression most likely to bite: it fails CLOSED (never verifies), so it is invisible unless explicitly checked.

preserves.behavior: Findings correct the code, never the assertions — do not relax corroboration to make a live run pass
applied_verified stays earned: only ever record LESS, never over-certify

verifications.description: Live run: combined PARTITION BY/ORDER BY table does not reach applied_verified unless partition_key is corroborated
ClickHouse ledger unit regressions still pass

work_units.evidence: Used chDB (ClickHouse embedded in-process) via BenchBox's own ClickHouseLocalClient — a real ClickHouse engine and the same system.tables catalog a server exposes, so no container was needed. Drove the real adapter path: _optimize_table_definition -> connection.execute -> _record_tuned_sort_key_op -> ClickHouseTuningIntrospector -> corroborate. Live catalog confirmed: sorting_key='l_orderkey, l_linenumber', partition_key='toYYYYMM(l_shipdate)'
work_units.summary: Stand up a live ClickHouse and run a tuned benchmark that renders both a PARTITION BY and an ORDER BY

work_units.evidence: Live: executing the tuned CREATE TABLE WITHOUT the PARTITION BY while the ledger records the tuned intent leaves catalog partition_key='' -> verdict 'absent' -> status applied_unverified, even though sort_key corroborated. Over-certification on the sort key alone is blocked against a real engine
work_units.summary: Confirm an uncorroborated partition_key blocks applied_verified

work_units.evidence: Live: a date-partitioned table DOES reach applied_verified — both sort_key and partition_key corroborated against the real catalog value 'toYYYYMM(l_shipdate)'. Proved the test catches the fail-closed regression by reverting _KEY_CLAUSE_COLUMNS to the pre-#1331 '[^)]*' form: test_date_partitioned_table_earns_verification then fails (applied_unverified). This was the invisible risk — nothing errors, runs just never verify
work_units.summary: Confirm a date-partitioned table (toYYYYMM) DOES corroborate — guards the regex fix failing closed

work_units.evidence: Live: CREATE TABLE recorded at execute time then a real OPTIMIZE TABLE lineitem FINAL executed and recorded; ledger executed_statements order is ['CREATE','OPTIMIZE'], so applied_ledger_hash attests true chronology
work_units.summary: Confirm applied_ledger_hash orders CREATE TABLE before OPTIMIZE TABLE
